surface_mechanism_description: The surface reaction mechanism involves the alternating pulses of metal precursors and oxidants, where the SnOx and TiO2 precursors chemisorb onto the surface, followed by the reaction with ozone. The growth of SnTiOx thin films is achieved through the self-limiting surface reactions of the precursors, with the Sn/Ti atomic layer deposition (ALD) cycle ratio of 2:3. The annealing conditions under different ambient gases (N2, 4% H2, and O2) influence the crystallinity and phase structure of the films.
